name: bulk-runner
title: Bulk Runner
description: Shows live done/failed/remaining counts. Pause and Stop let in-flight items finish, then say exactly what was and wasn't done. Failures are grouped by reason with retry-failed-only, and progress never jumps backwards.

meta.stops: Bulk job half done, nobody knows
meta.summary: Runs a bulk job with live done, failed and remaining counts, so a stopped or failed job never ends in "some of it happened, probably".
meta.server: Make each item operation idempotent and record per-item results on the server, so a retry or a reloaded tab doesn't repeat completed work.
catches: Unclear state after a stop, by reporting exactly what was done and left untouched
Repeated failures, grouped by reason and sorted by count
Retrying everything, by offering retry of failed items only
Runaway parallelism, via a concurrency limit
limits: Runs in the browser tab: closing or reloading the tab stops the job and loses its progress
Pause and Stop wait for in-flight items; it cannot cancel a request already sent
Retries call your run function again, so it must be safe to repeat
a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/max and an aria-valuetext reading done, failed and remaining
Phase changes are announced in an aria-live="polite" paragraph
All controls are native buttons with visible text
